admin.name: Muhammad Hamdan
admin.title: Full Stack Developer | SQA Engineer
admin.bio: MERN Stack Developer and Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer with a Bachelor of Computer Science from the University of Okara. Passionate about building secure, scalable web applications and ensuring flawless user experiences through comprehensive manual and automated testing. IELTS Band 7.5 certified and actively targeting international roles in Germany and Australia.

projects.title: Discover Zone
projects.description: Final Year Project — a comprehensive MERN stack platform featuring personality testing via MBTI and OCEAN models, secure authentication, and a full-featured admin dashboard for results analytics.
projects.problemSolved: Solved the challenge of integrating scientifically-validated personality models (MBTI + OCEAN) with a real-time admin panel, enabling counselors and educators to track and analyze student personality profiles at scale.
projects.role: Lead Full-Stack Developer & SQA Engineer — designed architecture, built all APIs, implemented JWT auth, and wrote E2E test suite with Cypress.

projects.title: Survey Application
projects.description: A cross-platform React Native mobile application designed for field survey data collection — featuring offline-first mobile forms, real-time survey reports, and secure user authentication.
projects.problemSolved: Enabled field workers to collect survey data in areas with limited connectivity using an offline-first architecture that syncs automatically when back online.
projects.role: Mobile Developer — built all screens with Expo, implemented offline storage with AsyncStorage, and integrated backend sync API.

projects.title: QA Automation Framework
projects.description: An end-to-end automation testing suite built with Cypress and Postman, integrated into a CI/CD GitHub Actions pipeline for comprehensive API and UI regression validation.
projects.problemSolved: Decreased regression testing time by 75% and automated structured bug reporting flows directly into project tracking tools, eliminating manual test cycles.
projects.role: QA Automation Engineer — designed the full framework, wrote custom Cypress commands, built Postman collections, and configured GitHub Actions pipeline.

experiences.description: Worked on frontend development with React.js and backend APIs with Node.js/Express. Handled database management with MongoDB, performed API integration, and contributed to production features for client-facing applications.
Responsible for end-to-end manual testing, regression testing cycles, writing comprehensive test cases, API testing with Postman, and structured bug reporting with detailed reproduction steps.

messages.name: Jane Miller
messages.subject: QA Automation Opportunities in Munich
messages.message: Hi Hamdan, we loved your QA automation work on GitHub! We have several roles open for SQA engineers with React/Next experience. Let me know if you are open to discussing opportunities in Germany.
